audience: publishers who promote brands with tracking links in Partnerize

useCases.title: Check which campaigns are approved
useCases.text: List the campaigns in the approved, pending or rejected state. Read the publisher account to confirm which account the login reaches.

useCases.title: Review conversions and payments
useCases.text: Read the conversions report for a date range, filtered by status. Summarize payments and list the self-billing invoices.

useCases.title: Browse creatives, vouchers and commissions
useCases.text: List the banners and text links, voucher codes and commission rates of one campaign.

useCases.title: Review tracking links
useCases.text: List the tracking links. Open one to see its campaign, destination URL and parameters.

useCases.title: Create a tracking link for a campaign
useCases.text: Create a new tracking link for one campaign. Existing links do not change.

useCases.title: Switch a tracking link on or off
useCases.text: Change the destination, description, parameters or active state of one tracking link. Only the fields you pass change.
